goal: Die Tastaturreihenfolge des Browser-Masken-Baukastens explizit und robust machen: Palette, ein roving Zielspalten-Tabstop, Controls der platzierten Elemente und danach Preview-Toggles. Keine positiven tabindex-Werte und keine Persistenz.

guide_delta.summary: Die Hauptbereiche sind als Fokus-Stufen dokumentiert. Im 12-Spalten-Raster liegt nur eine Zielspalte im normalen Tabpfad; Pfeiltasten verschieben diesen Tabstop. Positive tabindex-Werte werden vermieden.

direct_dependencies: placement targets already support ArrowLeft and ArrowRight
I129 persistence boundary remains plan-only and closed
tests_required: run existing test_browser_shell.py as narrow browser-shell regression
palette precedes canvas and canvas precedes preview in DOM
only one placement target is in the normal tab sequence
ArrowLeft/ArrowRight moves the roving target tab stop
focus/click on a placement target makes it the current tab stop
tests_explicitly_not_run: database/repository tests because no persistence path changes
Control Plane tests because governance is unchanged
full product suite because the change is browser-local and targeted
new Chromium screenshot evidence because this is an accessibility-order slice, not the scheduled visual milestone
risks: positive tabindex values would create a fragile global order
all twelve placement targets in the tab sequence would create noisy keyboard navigation
programmatic focus changes must keep the roving tab stop synchronized
preview toggles must remain after editor controls in natural DOM order
non_changes: no JSON schema or SQLite changes
no HTTP write route or browser storage
expected_side_effects: Tab traverses the main editor in a stable documented stage order
the placement grid contributes one tab stop instead of twelve
arrow navigation selects the target that Tab will later revisit
